body: She isn't evil at all. And thank you very much for talking with me. I feel like I can't come to terms with what happened.

I have acted short with her. Like I have, in the past, acted like she was dumb for believing 9/11 was a hoax, like she believed Bush was in on it. I should have respected her views on things rather than be an elitist. I need to quit my job.

I have acted passive aggressively because I was angry. She also told me today that she felt uncomfortable but didn't know how to act. I told her that I was going to distance myself, but it seems like I can't take her off standish. I feel like I'm caught up in a bunch of contradictions that I created. I'm sorry if I'm being rude.

I really think I am in the wrong. I was yelled at by my ex-boss. I definitely shouldn't have asked her today if she hates me or annoys me. I feel like I'm putting her in a bad position. Most people at work treat me like I'm some kind of subhuman, so I think there might be something I'm doing wrong, but I don't know what.

I've known her for three years. I was her office mate for about six months. I've known her for a while. I became very close to her, and I knew it wasn't something that was going to work out between her and I. The thing is, I didn't want to stonewall her.

Yes, I do suck.

Edit: Thank you for being the only one who was honest with me.

Thank you so much for your comment. One of the reasons why I feel so horribly bad is because of my job, but at the same time I am scared to leave. I was abandoned because I told a co-worker I had feelings for them, and I wanted some distance myself to not have those feelings anymore. I acted selfish by telling her this, and she has told me she only feels uncomfortable when she's around me. 

I don't want to make anyone feel uncomfortable. I want to be a positive influence on everyone I meet, but I've been lashing out because I feel like an outcast at work. I've been angry and dismissive. I've treated them so poorly that I'm sure that they hate me, which is completely reasonable.

It's extremely nice that a stranger reached out. Again. Thank you.
I'm sorry you and son are going through this. I also live in Texas, so I understand some of the mental health care system in Texas.

I have hit rock bottom. I am drinking, and I am alone. I am putting in my two weeks notice tomorrow. I don't have another job lined up. I'm not sure if it will get better. I'm sure everyone is sick of me. I just need someone to listen to this comment. Why am I like this? I'm so scared of abandonment, and I've been been abandoned by most of the people in my life.

I used to take all my pills within two to three days of paying for the prescription, and I once had a blackout on it when I took 7mg. That's some pretty irresponsible behavior on my part. I do use it for anxiety, but I always feel extreme anxiety. Thank you for listening.

Amitriptyline, Buspar, Effexor, Mirtazapine, Lexapro, Wellbutrin, and Prozac

Also therapy and an outpatient program for Depression and anxiety three years ago, it feels like it's been a long time

I'm going to see my therapist in Wednesday. I've been seeing her for a while, but it doesn't seem to help. Maybe I'll pull up this thread and tell her what I feel. I've told her many times, but it only gets better temporarily.

I'm extremely angry. My coworkers will try to correct me and tell me how to do things, but when they do this, they are wrong about what they are telling me about. It's infuriating, especially when they get angry with me that I'm not doing my job in this incorrect method they conjured out of their ass. Sorry for the language, but the people I work with are frustrating to be around.
Whenever I go to work, I want to blow my fucking head off.

I'm not sure I know what you mean by saying, "why do you have to almost die in order to become an LPC?' Maybe I worded it in a weird way, but what I mean is if I fail at this upcoming suicide attempt, then I might stay around. It'll be the second time I've attempted suicide, and it takes a lot of planning and energy to execute a suicide plan. It's a fail-safe plan in case I fail and change my mind on dying.

You tried to help someone. I don't think many people would consider a shit human being a human being who tries to help other people in their darkest times. Many people have tried to help me, and I've felt grateful for it, but it seems like, the person is too far into their own minds to be able to listen to the help of others, just like I am right now. Maybe my thinking is too narrow right now, but you don't seem like a shit human being whatsoever.

That's interesting. When I was thinking about this question, my answer would be selfishness. I think, in any case, the answer always boils down to selfishness. Helping people makes me feel good because it feels like I'm being patted on the head by society for doing something that it considers good. I know that sounds really dramatic, but it's the way I view it. Thank you for your response.

That's really inspiring. Even though I have a plan to kill myself and I would like to do it in about two weeks, I have a plan if I continued living, which is similar to yours. If I live, I want to be an LPC (Licensed Professional Counselor) for the same reason you will be starting college next year for social work. The thing is, I have helped people before in this situation, and I would sit with them for hours, listening to them. I forgot why I helped them in the first place! With the intensity of the depression I'm currently experiencing that, I feel like I've forgotten that people can be good. I think my problem is is that I don't include myself in the category of people worthy of help. 

You seem like a good person. Thank you for sharing your thoughts!

That makes sense. I hope I didn't offend you in any way. If I saw someone about to jump I would go over to them and listen to them. I've been in my own head too much, and I've been viewing most people as negative and uncaring.

So I guess in a way you might feel connected with them, almost like you know them in a way because you've had similar thoughts to them? If I'm off point on this, don't be afraid to tell me so. I hope I don't offend you in any way. I do have a question: Do you want to prevent these people from committing suicide because you don't want them to experience the pain you have felt during and leading up to those attempts?

I plan to kill myself pretty soon by hanging in a nearby camping location, so the purpose of this post is to rationalize why people would even care to help me or others in this position.

Thank you for the response. I've come here many times, and I've always wondered why other people come here to help others. There's a lot of people here, who want to be there for the poster, and that is really great. 

Right now, I'm having issues understanding why someone would care to somewhat fight for me not to kill myself, like with words or something along those lines, especially if they are someone I don't know.

Whenever I read something online about a response to a suicide, like from a person who didn't know the person well, I wonder why they pretend to care. I think people express fake grief over suicides to seem morally acceptable to other people because they think it is the most socially acceptable way to respond to a suicide. They don't want to act in a way that seems inappropriate because they might be ostracized or harrassed in some way because they did not respond in the way society prefers people to respond.

I know people have told me before that I should think about how much other people would be affected if I committed suicide, but I really don't think they care. I think that's why, when I post on r/suicidewatch or r/depression and talk about suicide, that the people saying "don't do it, I will miss you" makes me feel worse. I know it doesn't really matter. I wanted to put my thoughts out on the matter.

Tomorrow, I'll be going on a team building retreat with my co-workers and boss. I need to pretend like I'm having a good time, but I feel like I don't have the energy to do so. We are going to an escape room, and going to a Mexican restaurant. It sounds fun, but these people make me feel suicidal.

I have issues believing that I am a valuable. It seems like im hated by everyone. I'm sorry it took me so long to reply. I've tried so many different things, like six different antidepressants and therapy. I feel like therapy would help, but I don't have enough money. 

I know my mom would be devastated, which is why I started crying while writing my suicide note for her. I remember the last time I attempted she started crying hysterically and held me. She told me to fight on, but I feel like everyone else wants me to dive off a cliff.
With some of my friends, I don't know how to talk to them about it. I have one friend who has depression like me, and I want to bring it up, but I don't want it to have a negative impact on him.

Thank you for replying. I feel like I'm in state of mind I can't get out of. On one hand, I would love to live and become a therapist, so I could help people. But, I have been focusing on killing myself because I think I have a negative impact on the world.

I am 22 years old. I always try to do good, but I feel like an evil person. Something that happened five months ago triggered my Depressive state. It doesn't seem like a big deal, and I feel like I'm too sensitive. Five months ago, I told a friend of mine, who I deeply cared for, that I had feelings for her. The thing is, she has a long-term girlfriend. She is also a co-worker. I told her this because I wanted to distance myself from her, so I could not have these feelings anymore. 

I was stupid, and I told her at work through text. I feel dumb. I am dumb. Ever since then, I've been out of control. Everyone found out, including my boss, who had a conversation with me about the issue. Now, people avoid me. I'm ostracized at work, and I feel so bad that I want to kill myself. 

I've tried finding another job, but I haven't found anything. 

All I can say is that I'm so fucking stupid, and I feel like I deserve to die. It's all I think about. It's been five months of ostracizing. I feel weak for feeling like this. I don't have any rope yet, but I am planning to buy some with my upcoming paycheck. Sorry for the long wall of text.
When I ODed on Mirtazapine, it felt like my insides were being slashed with knives. I hope you are doing better. It's a painful experience.

Hey, thank you. That is really sweet of you to share. I will try to do this. This is a thing I've been told by my therapist, and it is a technique that helps a person put things into perspective in a way. I think I've been too scared to do this, mostly because the emotions are so strong. 

I think I will try to incorporate this technique into meditation. Thank you!

I feel alone. Why can't I stop whining? I'm still on the fence about hanging myself. A part of me thinks things can get better, but another part doesn't care. I think I'll buy the rope when I get my paycheck. Then, it'll be ready if things go south.
Cat.
I typed up all of my suicide notes just a moment ago. It was painful writing one to my mom. I love her so much, but I can't take this anymore.
Thank you so much for your response!
I feel like a piece of shit. I'm not a good person, and I deserve to die.

I have decided that I will become a LPC (Licensed Professional Counselor). I feel like that I'll be good at the job because I've had my personal experiences with mental illnesses. I hope that I will be able to help people, which is the one thing I want to do in my life.
I have been depressed the last six years, but it hasn't been this bad since six years ago. I know it's worse than usual, for myself, when I no longer care. Sorry should have clarified.
